verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an MCP gateway and server platform like Gram, but the pack never documents meta-tools such as search_tools or load_tool that let an agent discover and load tool definitions at runtime. The closest items are skills that agents 'load on demand' (instruction manifests, not tool definitions), a docs-search MCP (searches documentation, not tools), and a platform MCP for admins to add servers (management, not runtime tool loading); all are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can search and load tools at runtime through meta-tools instead of having thousands of tool definitions stuffed into my context
